sources.title: Chikinchel
sources.note: A fragmentary stub: 'After the destruction of Mayapan (1441-1461)'; borders Tases and Cupul south, Ah Kin Chel west, Ekab east; north coast.

notes: NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no row for this province; Later Mayan City-States (1429-1546, 135,136 to 187,745 km2) covers the whole northern lowlands and contains it. The Kuchkabal page says the extent of the provinces 'is still debated' and that scholars disagree 'on whether they were territorial units or jurisdictions'; the shape here is a disc around the capital, soft, and no frontier is claimed. Cliopatria keeps its envelope to 1546 although the Spanish took the provinces one by one from 1527. CHIKINCHEL. Everything is bridge (confidence 1): the page is a fragmentary stub. The conquest page says Chikinchel and Cupul were 'mutually hostile' over the salt beds.
